title: A circuit is more than its switches
caption: Metal levels and insulating films are interleaved above the devices; contacts join the wiring to the transistors. The schematic groups each wiring tier with its surrounding dielectric.

nodes.label: Upper wiring and dielectric
nodes.detail: Metal routes carry signals and power within insulating films.

nodes.label: Local wiring and contacts
nodes.detail: Short routes connect to the transistor terminals; dielectric separates neighboring paths.

nodes.label: Transistors
nodes.detail: Control current near the silicon surface.

nodes.label: Silicon foundation
nodes.detail: Provides the crystalline material beneath the circuit.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: Four branches converge on fabrication
caption: The wafer is only one input. Designs, specialized materials and equipment must be ready together.

nodes.label: Prepared wafer
nodes.detail: A controlled crystal with a clean, flat surface.

nodes.label: Circuit design
nodes.detail: Defines the structures to manufacture.

nodes.label: Process materials
nodes.detail: Gases, chemicals and films support repeated changes.

nodes.label: Equipment
nodes.detail: Tools control where and how each change happens.

nodes.label: Fabricated circuit
nodes.detail: The branches meet in a qualified manufacturing flow.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: The circuit grows through repeated changes
caption: A processed surface becomes the starting point for the next sequence. Measurement helps catch accumulated errors.

nodes.label: Deposit
nodes.detail: Add material with the required electrical or process role.

nodes.label: Pattern
nodes.detail: Create temporary openings in a protective material.

nodes.label: Modify
nodes.detail: Remove material or alter selected regions.

nodes.label: Measure
nodes.detail: Check the resulting structures before continuing.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: Correct size is not enough: position matters
caption: The first two drawings compare contact placement in plan view. The third is a wafer edge profile: local alignment and whole-wafer geometry are different controls.

nodes.label: Aligned contact
nodes.detail: In this plan view, the small contact lands inside the larger target.

nodes.label: Offset contact
nodes.detail: The same contact shape can miss its target when the layers are displaced.

nodes.label: Wafer distortion
nodes.detail: Bending across the wafer changes the surface height seen by the imaging tool.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: Compute, memory and package work together
caption: The package provides short, dense connections between the GPU and HBM. Bandwidth, capacity and latency remain distinct properties.

nodes.label: GPU
nodes.detail: Consumes inputs and produces results.

nodes.label: HBM stack
nodes.detail: Holds working data in stacked DRAM dies.

nodes.label: Fine wiring
nodes.detail: Carries many signals between neighboring dies.

nodes.label: Package substrate
nodes.detail: Connects the assembly to power and the board.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: A substitute must work inside the whole process
caption: Qualification tests compatibility and reliability in context. A nominally similar material can require recipe changes and another evaluation loop.

nodes.label: Candidate input
nodes.detail: Choose a possible replacement material or tool.

nodes.label: Process integration
nodes.detail: Run it with the other steps and interfaces.

nodes.label: Device evidence
nodes.detail: Measure behavior and evaluate reliability.

nodes.label: Qualified flow
nodes.detail: Accept the input only for the demonstrated conditions.
